nodes.label: Obsidian Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style obsidian block texture. Very dark purple-black surface with irregular swirling glassy patterns and faint violet/purple highlights suggesting volcanic glass. Pixel noise creates a mottled, crystalline appearance. Color palette: near-black base (#0A0A10), deep purple-black (#1A1025), subtle violet highlights (#2A1A3A), faint lighter specks. Game purpose: extremely blast-resistant building block obtained by water cooling lava; used for Nether portals, enchanting tables, and high-durability structures.
nodes.pattern: swirling dark glassy pattern with violet undertones and pixel noise
